openai.label: OpenAI
openai.hint: Hosted GPT models. Paste an OpenAI API key.

anthropic.label: Anthropic (Claude)
anthropic.hint: Hosted Claude models. Paste an Anthropic API key. (Claude has no embeddings — keep embeddings local.)

google.label: Google (Gemini)
google.hint: Hosted Gemini models. Paste a Google AI Studio key.

azure.label: Azure OpenAI
azure.hint: GPT models from your Azure OpenAI resource. Model ids are your deployment names — paste your key and resource base URL.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter
openrouter.hint: One key, many upstream models. Use provider-prefixed ids like anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.

openaiCompatible.label: Local / self-hosted (OpenAI-compatible)
openaiCompatible.hint: Ollama, vLLM, or llama.cpp on your own hardware. No key — just a base URL.
